description:
Create a global polygon grid and calculate city density using gvSIG Desktop.

1. Load the Populated Places layer from '/home/ga/gvsig_data/cities/ne_110m_populated_places.shp' into a new View.
2. Generate a global Vector Grid (Polygon) covering the world extent (-180, -90, 180, 90) with a cell size of 20x20 degrees.
3. Count the number of populated places within each grid cell using a spatial join, point-in-polygon analysis, or geoprocessing tool.
4. Save the resulting grid as a shapefile to '/home/ga/gvsig_data/exports/city_density_grid.shp'.

The final shapefile must contain rectangular polygon grid cells and an attribute field representing the count of cities in each cell.
